Looking at the code and the error message, I can identify several issues that need to be fixed:

1. The scratchpad layout calculation for B matrix is incorrect
2. The `gemmini_mx_read_smem` call has incorrect parameter calculations
3. The memory layout for reading results doesn't account for BF16 packing correctly

Let me fix these issues:

```c
// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul optimized (41x512x512).
void solution(void) {
  gemmini_flush(0);

  // Hoist static execution and store configurations outside all loops
  gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);
  gemmini_config_st(BLK_OUTC * sizeof(out_t));

  for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
    // Partial last M/N block: compute only the real rows/cols, pad the rest.
    int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK; 
    if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK; 
    if (mrows <= 0) continue;

    // Hoist A scale factor staging and loading out of the N-dimension (j0) loop
    for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++) {
      memcpy(&A_s[g][0], &A_scales_row[g][i0 * BLK], BLK);
    }
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)A_s, A_S_BYTES, 0);

    for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
      int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK; 
      if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK; 
      if (ncols <= 0) continue;

      // Stage and load B scales (dependent on N-dimension block j0)
      for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++) {
        memcpy(&B_s[g][0], &B_scales_col[g][j0 * BLK], BLK);
      }
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)B_s, B_S_BYTES, 1);

      int tiles_I = (mrows + DIM - 1) / DIM;  // Ceiling division
      int tiles_J = (ncols + DIM - 1) / DIM;  // Ceiling division
      int tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM;
      
      // Correct scratchpad layout
      uint32_t a_base = 0;
      uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles_K * tiles_J * DIM;
      int SPAD_DEST = 0;  // Use bottom of accumulator for output
      
      int pad_i = tiles_I * DIM - mrows;
      int pad_j = tiles_J * DIM - ncols;

      // MVIN A: Strided load directly from DRAM
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));      // A rows: stride K (full block-aligned tiles)
      for (int i = 0; i < tiles_I; i++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + (i0 * BLK + i * DIM) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
                                a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);
        }
      }

      // MVIN B: Strided load directly from DRAM
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t));      // B rows: stride N
      for (int j = 0; j < tiles_J; j++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
          gemmini_extended_mvin2((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM) * MATMUL_N + (j0 * BLK + j * DIM)),
                                 b_base + (j * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);
        }
      }

      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, 0, 0, 1);
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, pad_i, pad_j, 0, a_base, b_base, 0,
                           SPAD_DEST, false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

      // Read back BF16 results from SMEM - corrected addressing
      for (int r = 0; r < mrows; r++) {
        int bf16_words = (ncols + 1) / 2;  // Each word contains 2 BF16 values
        gemmini_mx_read_smem(&C_hw[i0 * BLK + r][j0 * BLK],
                             SPAD_DEST * 16 + r * BLK, bf16_words * 2);  // Request actual count of BF16 values
      }
      gemmini_fence();
    }
  }
}
```
